reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and the cited text supports it: clause 7.6 runs in our favour (Vendor warrants Fees to Customer will be no less favourable than those offered to similarly situated customers), which the rule's detection guidance directs to be marked compliant and left un-redlined.
Clause 12.3 affirmatively confirms Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment, corroborating the absence of any Customer-side MFN obligation.
Redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment was added, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; no deterministic check failures.
